pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/ci-enhanced-tests-on-push
pullRequests.body:
Each e2e file starts its own Vite server, and run in parallel they pre-bundle into the same cache: ENOTEMPTY: rename .vite/deps_ssr_temp_… -> .vite/deps_ssr, which broke launcher-android at random. The e2e files now run one at a time.
(The other half of this PR, running the enhanced Vulkan tests on pushes, landed separately in #307.)

pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: feature/menu-start-select
pullRequests.body:
Before: L3 opened the in-game menu by default. But L3 does things in the game: in rac1 it shows the health and bolt counter for a few seconds, and held in the jet fighter (Pokitaru, Gemlik, Drek's Fleet) it turns sharper. Opening the menu also pressed those.
After: Start and Select pressed together open and close the menu. The game never sees the pair, so it neither pauses nor opens the map. A lone Start or Select still reaches the game: after at most 100 ms, or at once as a tap when let go…

pullRequests.title: fix: make right stick sensitivity speed up the camera
pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: fix/stick-sensitivity-camera
pullRequests.body:
Before: Stick sensitivity only scaled the stick reading. A full push is already the largest value the game reads, so at 300% the camera turned at the same speed as at 100% (only small pushes changed).
After: Above 100%, the right stick turns the follow camera faster at a full push, up to the set amount (300% = 3x). At 100% nothing changes.
How: tune_stick returns how far past a full push the sensitivity took the right stick's x (Pad::camera_speed). The game hosts multiply the follow camera's…

pullRequests.title: fix(rac2): the race and crane HUD wrappers return nothing on PAL and v2.00 too
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/rac2-hud-void
pullRequests.body: #341 and #343 landed side by side. #343's race and crane HUD wrappers are void (void), and v1.01's interface already says so, but PAL's and v2.00's asm_interface.json were written before those functions were wrapped and still read int, so the two new programs failed to compile (conflicting types for 'func_L04_0040C228' and three more). These four entries per release are what a fresh run from the disc writes, since the host C's signature settles them.

largest byte the game reads, so above 100% the camera turned no faster.
The part of the push past full now multiplies the follow camera's yaw
target (rac1 PAL/NTSC, rac2), and the late camera latch uses the same
factor. At 100% nothing changes.
